name: Divider · Short rule · Ink
notes: Module bank. All copy is a labelled slot: replace it before use.

adaptations: Figma's divider was a rule plus a usage note ('48px rhythm'): the note is dropped; the divider is a v6 card holding the short coral rule, so it keeps the flush stack
Use it where two blocks share a surface and need a break; where the surface can change instead, change the surface (the composition guide's seam rule)
